R/ PAX AVG ; D/ IMP CARAV(SIVS PF AVG)

A Roman copper alloy coin: radiate of Carausius dating AD286-293. Mint: London. Reverse inscription: PAX AVG. Obverse: Radiate and draped bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP CARAV(SIVS PF AVG). Reverse: Pax with vertical sceptre. Reverse inscription: PAX AVG. Mint mark: F/O//ML (FO officina letters, ML - Moneta Londiniensis).
